title: feat(entk13): enter-body restores k=13 reverse: t=25 vs t=43
science: Enter-body rule eps = mu + cost 3 on every 2->3 hop RESTORES same-k reverse at k=13 on B_39: t=25 vs 43, 1875>1849. This is the band's first push past the mu wall. Mechanism: pricing the 2->3 hop lifts the axis intercept from +10 to +12 and the body from 3k+2 to 3k+4, and the axis gain dominates.
